description: QGroundControl is open in Fly View showing a connected simulated ArduPilot copter. A real sample mission file is available at /home/ga/Documents/QGC/sample_mission.plan for reference. The agent must: (1) Click the Q icon at the top-left of the toolbar to open the navigation menu, (2) Click 'Plan Flight' to switch to Plan View, (3) Create a new mission with at least 3 waypoints forming a triangle or polygon pattern around the home position, (4) Set each waypoint altitude to 50 meters, (5) Upload the mission to the vehicle by clicking the 'Upload' button. The mission should be a simple survey-style flight path that the copter could follow autonomously.
